outcome: Rate of cephalic presentation at delivery
Presentation of fetus after the first and last ECVs
cohort: 160 healthy primiparous women with breech presentation at a tertiary hospital in Israel between February 2016 and July 2017
finding: Early initiation of ECV (35-36 weeks) in primiparous women increased the chance of immediate cephalic presentation but had no significant effect on presentation at delivery or cesarean delivery rate compared to late ECV (37-38 weeks).
mod_finding: While early initiation of external cephalic version (ECV) increased the chance of immediate cephalic presentation, it had no effect on presentation at delivery or cesarean delivery rate compared to late ECV.
